description: Source code for managing FOU (Foo Over UDP) network links on Linux using netlink, including functions for adding, deleting, listing, and deserializing FOU configurations.

methods.name: FouFamilyId
methods.description: Retrieves the netlink family ID for 'fou', caching the result.

methods.name: FouAdd
methods.description: Adds a new FOU configuration via netlink.

methods.name: FouDel
methods.description: Deletes a FOU configuration via netlink.

methods.name: FouList
methods.description: Lists existing FOU configurations via netlink.

methods.name: deserializeFouMsg
methods.description: Deserializes a netlink message into a Fou struct.
